title: Tab picks in the pickers, sharper fuzzy search, shortcuts ready out of the box
request:
A user mentioned it was important to be able to start timers and toggle them with a keyboard shortcut easily with the desktop/Mac app - is this possible? It must be incredibly easy for the user to work with.

Also I noticed sometimes I’m typing in a field like project and expect the first result to select when hitting tab but it doesn’t - it should be a super efficient fast powerful fuzzy search where tabbing easily selects and moves to the next field. Please ensure the desktop app is as streamlined and polished as posssible
interpretation: Global hotkeys already existed but every one shipped unbound behind Settings › Keyboard shortcuts, so nobody had a shortcut until they found that tab; on a Mac, start/stop, new timer and show/hide now come bound. In the project and task search, Tab left the field with its old value (typing "des", Tab, ⌘↵ started the timer on the previous project); Tab now takes the highlighted match and moves to the next field, exactly as Return does. The matcher was also tightened so loose queries stop listing unrelated projects, and rows mark the characters that matched.
changes: Search pickers: Tab picks the highlighted row and moves on (project → task search → date); ⇧Tab in the task search reopens the project search
Tab with a query that matches nothing stays in the field; Tab through an untouched list changes nothing
Matcher: whole word > word start > initials ("wr") > inside a word > abbreviation ("dsgn"); scattered letters no longer match
Ties: a match in the project name before one in the client, then most recently tracked first
Accent-free typing also covers ø, ł, ß, æ ("sondergaard", "lodz"); word starts work in non-Latin scripts
Rows, client headings and preset rows mark the matched characters (tint, no weight change)
Presets search: highlight on the best match, ↑↓ walk it, Return starts it
Mac: ⌃⌥⌘S start/stop, ⌃⌥⌘N new timer, ⌃⌥⌘Z show/hide bound on first launch; rows already bound are kept, a cleared default stays cleared
Shortcuts tab: one line saying these work from any app; tray tooltip names the start/stop hotkey
Start/stop pressed where it cannot start anything (locked week, invoiced entry, failed request) shows the popover instead of doing nothing
